study_question: Which components of a just transition become concrete within JETPs, with what public/private financing, and from which pre-existing operations?
unit: canonical operation or documented component; sources are evidence rather than additional units
scope: public and private finance explicitly linked to a JETP; extended-only observations remain visible but cannot enter the strict finance panel
selection_rule: Diagnostic, not representative: select two named operations per country from existing local registers, covering energy infrastructure plus either fossil exit or social accompaniment where a named record exists. Include an incomplete, unsigned, extended-only or plan-only case when it is the contrasting named record. This rule was recorded after prior inspection of local sources; the exercise is not blind or preregistered before outcome inspection.

dimensions.A: documented transition function plus financial or implementation state
dimensions.B: strict-scope, source-linked financing observation with ownership classification; mixed unallocated is not split
dimensions.C: at least one pre-JETP and one post-JETP operational milestone, with event dates distinct from publication/observation dates

lifecycle_taxonomy.rule: Financial and implementation states are separate fields and may not be aggregated into a single maturity score. The denominator for each financial state is unique strict-scope operations with a source-linked financing observation; the denominator for each implementation state is unique selected operations with a source-linked implementation observation. A, B and C each retain their own denominator; no aggregate or figure may combine them.

money_semantics: A pledge is an announced intention, an allocation is a designated prospective resource, an approval is a financing decision, a signed contribution is a documented agreement, and a disbursement is a payment. They are distinct lifecycle observations. A contribution is counted once by its documented accounting identity. Project cost, plan need, successive snapshots and contributions are not summed. Cross-currency totals require a stated common basis and deduplication decision; this diagnostic reports source currencies only.
date_semantics: Event dates, publication dates and observation dates are distinct. Unknown event timing remains unknown; a publication date cannot be recoded as a signature or implementation date.

coverage_universe.definition: Eight selected named operations, two per country, in the local structured evidence available by 2026-09-15. This is a finite diagnostic frame, not the partnership portfolio.
source_country_periods: ZAF | zaf-jet-investment-register-q1-2026 | 2026-Q1 register edition | projects.csv and events.csv
IDN | idn-jetp-progress-report-2025 | report cutoff 2025-11-30 | events.csv and implementation-events.csv
IDN | idn-gfanz-saguling-2025; idn-project-cirebon-framework-marubeni; idn-news-cirebon-retirement-reuters-2025 | source editions held in source-claims.csv | source-claims.csv
VNM | vnm-pilot-observation-018; vnm-pilot-observation-020 | local pilot source observations through 2026-09-15 | vnm-pilot-observations.csv
SEN | sen-investment-plan-l4-mirror; sen-afd-diass-storage; sen-diass-groundbreaking-2026; sen-aner-project-27 | local source editions through 2026-09-15 | events.csv and implementation-events.csv

permitted_comparisons: documentary coverage by country and dimension
reported financing states and ownership where source-linked
prohibited_claims: private amount inferred from mixed package
0817_handoff: Acquire or reconcile only the missing strict-link, ownership, event-date, pre/post-history and duplicate/snapshot evidence revealed by the matrix; do not treat these eight cases as a portfolio census.
